keyHistoryEntry.description: A snapshot of the members array at a previous rotation. Preserved so remaining members can still decrypt documents uploaded under older group keys.

main.description: A named keyring for group-based access control. Contains a group symmetric key wrapped to each member's DID public key. Analogous to git-crypt's named keys — documents encrypted under this keyring are accessible to all members without per-document key management.

opakeVersion.description: Schema version for the app.opake.* namespace. Clients should reject records with a version they do not understand.

description.description: Optional description of this keyring's purpose.

algo.description: The symmetric algorithm the group key is intended for.

members.description: The group key wrapped to each member's DID public key. Each entry allows that DID to recover the group key.

rotation.description: Key rotation counter. Increment when the group key is rotated (e.g. after revoking a member). Documents should reference the rotation they were encrypted under.

keyHistory.description: Previous rotation snapshots. Each entry preserves the members array from before a rotation so remaining members can still unwrap group keys for pre-rotation documents.
